contracts_rationale: Mission defines no interfaces: it publishes the EXISTING contracts/mission-status + mission-write OpenAPI documents (via bundle.py --bundle-only) and the committed JSON Schemas as docs pages. No endpoint, payload, webhook or integration shape is created or changed (C-004).
friendly_name: Docs site overhaul: doc-kitty 0.6.0, service docs, schema and API reference
purpose_context: The docs site and README still describe spec-kitty-events as a Python package only, although the repository now also hosts the events-domain read and write services on their own release line. Readers cannot browse the event schemas or the service APIs without opening repository files. This mission adopts doc-kitty 0.6.0 to publish schema and API reference pages, and refreshes the README, entry, architecture and planning docs so they match what the repository ships. It closes #181, #193, #194 and #195 in one change.
purpose_tldr: Bring the spec-kitty-events docs site up to doc-kitty 0.6.0 and make the read and write services, their APIs and the event schemas visible to readers.
